relationships.statement: "End-to-end tests must exercise the egg page through its public contract, verifying the egg emoji and the word 'Eggs' below it as a visitor sees them, driven by a test runner that checks those outcomes; the test runner and its configuration are not chosen here." depends on "Tests must select elements by their visible output, not by internal classes or ids, because internal classes may change without a change to what the page shows.".
conditions: End-to-end tests select elements by visible output, which requires tests to select by visible output rather than internal classes or ids
